title: Finitely presented infinite simple amenable groups
exact_target: Does there exist an infinite simple amenable group that is finitely presented? A finitely generated example alone is insufficient. The source also proposes the derived subgroup of the full group of the Penrose tiling as a possible construction to test for these properties.
